'''Trace''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] he was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], undercover as an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] officer.<ref name="TOR" />
